candidates.name: hairpin_anticipation_overspeed_penalty
candidates.rationale: This experiment aims to encourage earlier braking and prevent overspeeding into sharp turns by increasing the lookahead for sharp turns and introducing a small penalty for exceeding target corner speeds, directly targeting full-throttle-into-hairpin behavior.

candidates.name: apex_decel_stronger_lower_target_speed
candidates.rationale: This experiment focuses on improving apex setup and promoting earlier deceleration by increasing the reward for decelerating when approaching apexes and slightly lowering the target speed for corners, building on a recently successful pattern.
